value.name: urge patience before selling house
value.description: Lucia warns Daniel that rushing to sell the house could cost the family more than the property itself.
evidence: Lucia: "Daniel, please, if we rush to sell this house, we risk losing more than just a property; we could lose the very essence of who we are as a family—let's take the time to uncover our mother's true intentions."

value.name: seek mother's true intentions
value.description: Lucia proposes delaying the sale so the family can uncover their mother's true intentions.
evidence: Lucia: "Daniel, please, if we rush to sell this house, we risk losing more than just a property; we could lose the very essence of who we are as a family—let's take the time to uncover our mother's true intentions."

value.name: pause house sale decision

evidence: Asha: "Let’s pause any decisions about the sale until we thoroughly search for the missing codicil; understanding our mother’s intentions is crucial, and I believe that together we can navigate this with both care and clarity."
